summary: Rail Vision Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing its selection for MxV Rail's locomotive sensor pre-integration testing program under the Association of American Railroads' TCCO Technology Roadmap Program. The testing supports development of Restricted Speed Enforcement capabilities. CEO David BenDavid commented on the milestone. No financial terms, share prices, or strategic transactions are disclosed. This is a routine business development update, not a special-situation event. What to watch: potential future commercial agreements or technology adoption by Class I railroads.
